segments.title: 第83章 你的同桌班長叫什么?
segments.content:
Reigniting the Prime of Youth Chapter 83: What's Your Deskmate Class Monitor's Name?

"Li Luo really knows how to cook." Yan Zhusheng said, sitting at the dining table and watching Ying Chanxi bring out dish after dish of food that looked, smelled, and tasted wonderful.

"And it tastes really good, too." It wasn't time to eat yet, but Xu Youyu could barely restrain herself. She secretly reached out, picked up a piece of pork rib, and popped it into her mouth, hissing and blowing on it.

"When you guys lived together, did Li Luo cook?"

"He did." Xu Youyu chuckled. "Every day after evening self-study, he would make some fried noodles or fried rice for us as a late-night snack."

"You can't cook in the school dorms." Yan Zhusheng sighed. "But I don't know how to cook either."

"Haha," Xu Youyu laughed, then joked, "Li Luo's apartment still has a spare room that hasn't been rented out. Why don't you just move in with us?"

"I'm already living at school." Yan Zhusheng shook her head. "If I really wanted to move out, I'd have to talk to my mom."

"I was just saying." Xu Youyu said playfully. "Besides, your house is so big. The empty room at our place is quite small. It'd be bad if you weren't comfortable."

Yan Zhusheng didn't mind whether the room was big or not. After all, school dorms were small to begin with; no matter how small Li Luo's spare room was, it would still be more comfortable than a dorm room.

And compared to the girls in her dorm, perhaps it would be more relaxing and comfortable to be with girls like Xu Youyu and Ying Chanxi.

At the very least, she probably wouldn't have to worry about them excluding her.

But Yan Zhusheng was just thinking about it. She had promised her mother she would try her best to adapt to school life.

Her mother had finally recovered her health and was planning to return to her career. Yan Zhusheng didn't want to hold her back.

"But even if you continue to live at the dorms, you can still come over to our place on weekends," Xu Youyu added. "There's a piano and a guitar there, too, so you probably won't get bored."

Yan Zhusheng was slightly surprised, then nodded. "Okay, sure."

A short while later, all six dishes and one soup were on the table.

After the four of them were seated, Yan Zhusheng picked up her chopsticks, tried a dish, and her eyes lit up slightly. "Delicious."

"Told you so," Xu Youyu, beside her, also started digging in.

"As long as it's delicious." Li Luo noticed Yan Zhusheng's reaction and nodded in satisfaction.

This time, he had once again treated them all equally, making two of each of the three girls' favorite dishes.

Like Yan Zhusheng, for example. In his past life, she had especially loved his stir-fried eel with shredded bamboo shoots and chicken with chili peppers. It seemed that was still the case now.

After they finished eating, Yan Zhusheng said there was no need to wash the dishes, and they could just leave them for the cleaning lady to take care of tomorrow.

So Li Luo and the other two tidied up, put on their school bags, and said their goodbyes.

Staring at the now-empty living room, Yan Zhusheng's expression was blank for a moment. She suddenly felt an emptiness in her heart and was a little unaccustomed to it.

But just a few minutes after Li Luo and the others had left, there was a sound at the front door.

The door was opened from the outside. Yuan Wanqing walked in with a small bag slung over her shoulder and immediately met the gaze of her daughter on the sofa.

"Mom, you're back?" Yan Zhusheng was a little surprised, tilting her head to look at the doorway. "Did something happen?"

Ordinarily, Yuan Wanqing had been busy with her new album lately, so she shouldn't have had time to come back.

"The songs for the album are mostly recorded. There are two more that need some adjustment, so we'll record them in a couple of days." Yuan Wanqing said with a smile. "So I came back to see how you're doing at school."

"I'm doing great."

"Are you used to living in the dorm?" Yuan Wanqing changed her shoes and walked over to sit down on the sofa. "How are you getting along with your roommates?"

"...Also great."

"What about your homeroom teacher? What's he like?"

"Teacher Kong is very nice, too," Yan Zhusheng said. "He even chose me to be the athletics representative."

"Oh?" Yuan Wanqing was surprised for a moment, then couldn't help but laugh. "Why not the arts representative or something? You're much better at music than sports."

"I broke the school record in sprinting in middle school," Yan Zhusheng reminded her.

"That's true." Yuan Wanqing nodded. "What about other things? Let me think... like your deskmate?"

"My deskmate is very nice, too." Yan Zhusheng blinked. "He's also our class monitor, a very capable person."

"A boy or a girl?"

"A boy."

"I see." Yuan Wanqing nodded knowingly. Then her eyes swept over the leftover food on the table, and she let out a soft "oh?" at the right moment. "Who cooked dinner tonight? The cleaning lady called me this afternoon and said you told her she didn't need to come today."

"Yeah, my classmates did."

"It seems you're getting along really well with your classmates." Yuan Wanqing smiled. "With so much food, there must have been quite a few people?"

"There were three of them. One of them is the class monitor, and the other two are girls," Yan Zhusheng answered honestly, hiding nothing. "They're all very nice."

"Did you cook together?" Yuan Wanqing asked curiously.

Yan Zhusheng shook her head. "The class monitor cooked. It was delicious."

"Even more delicious than what the cleaning lady makes?" Yuan Wanqing teased.

"Yes." Yan Zhusheng nodded honestly. "It really is a bit more delicious."

"..." Yuan Wanqing's smile froze. To think that this cleaning lady, whom she had carefully selected, was not even as good as a high school student at cooking.

Could it be...

"What's your class monitor's name?"

"Li Luo."

"Which 'Luo'?"

"The 'Luo' from yingluo. With the king radical, and the 'ge' from tian ge yi fang."

Yuan Wanqing nodded in understanding, then patted Yan Zhusheng's head. "I'm relieved that you're able to make friends at school. But no matter what, I hope you can share more things with me and not keep them bottled up inside, okay?"

"...Okay."

Meanwhile, Li Luo and the others returned home.

Tossing his bag onto the sofa, Li Luo asked, "What are you guys doing tonight? Homework?"

"I finished it during class on Friday," said Ying Chanxi.

"Same here." Xu Youyu glanced at Li Luo. "Don't tell me you haven't finished your homework yet. Even if you didn't have time on Friday, there were four self-study periods this morning."

"Er... I still have biology left." The corner of Li Luo's mouth twitched.

To be honest, with full concentration, it wouldn't have been difficult for Li Luo to finish all his homework during the two evening self-study periods on Friday, plus the three self-study periods today aside from the class committee election.

But his foundation from middle school was still relatively weak, so he preferred to do his homework while thoroughly understanding the concepts, which slowed him down a bit.

But he had to return to school tomorrow, Sunday evening, for two more self-study periods. Finishing the homework for just one subject, biology, was more than enough time.

But compared to the class monitor of Class 1 and the top student of the grade, he really couldn't measure up.

"You guys do your homework during class. Don't you listen to the teacher?" Li Luo really couldn't understand.

"I do listen." Ying Chanxi nodded and thought for a moment before saying, "But I always prepare in advance, go through the exercise book first to make sure I've got all the concepts down."

"If I have any questions, I just write them down first."

"Then during class, I can do my homework while listening to the teacher. When he gets to a part I have a question about, I'll stop and listen carefully. After I understand it, I'll continue with my homework."

"Pretty much." Xu Youyu nodded and said, "But I listen for one period and do homework for one period, striking a balance. If there's anything I really don't understand, I just ask the teacher right after class."

Li Luo was speechless.

He suddenly realized that even with his "memory palace," when it came to studying, he still couldn't quite comprehend the world of top students.

These people were just ridiculously impressive.

Could a normal person like him even survive?

Living under the same roof with you two, my cheat ability feels like it's not even turned on... Li Luo couldn't help but complain in his head.

"Tonight, I need to read the letters I received today." Ying Chanxi said, holding her bag as she walked toward her bedroom. "I received so many this time, and I have to reply to each one."

"Xi Xi, you even reply to every single one?" Xu Youyu was a little surprised. "I just don't reply to the ones I'm not interested in."

"Mm..." Ying Chanxi gave a helpless smile. "I just feel it would be a bit impolite not to reply. Of course, I'm not saying you're wrong to do so, it's just how I feel."

"Don't tell me you're going to be pen pals with all these people?" Li Luo asked with a raised eyebrow.

At Li Luo's question, Ying Chanxi's face immediately stiffened. "If that's what you want to think, I can't be bothered to say more."

Then she huffed, turned around, and went back to her bedroom with slapping sounds from her slippers, slamming the door shut with a bang.

"That was a really unnecessary question," Xu Youyu tut-tutted. "Now Xi Xi is mad."

Li Luo was speechless. "...Why do I get the feeling you're enjoying this?"

"Tch." Xu Youyu pursed her lips. "I actually made a rare exception and agreed to be your pen pal. No one else in the literary society got that privilege. You should be counting your lucky stars."

"Wasn't it just for my fried noodles?"

"You talk too much." Xu Youyu rolled her eyes at him, picked up her bag, and walked toward her bedroom. As she passed by Li Luo, she didn't forget to give him a kick before running into her bedroom with a laugh, shutting the door behind her.

Li Luo shook his head, speechless, thinking that this girl was as childish as ever.

Even after graduating from college, she was always cheerful and laughing, and she never forgot to seize the opportunity to kick him a couple of times even when she was sick in bed.

With that thought, Li Luo decided not to go back to his bedroom. He just carried his bag to the desk in the living room, sat down, and took out the five letters he had received today.

They were from Liu Shaowen, Hua Xiuxiu, Ying Chanxi, Xu Youyu, and Qin Yawei.

After some thought, Li Luo picked up Liu Shaowen's and Qin Yawei's letters first, intending to see what these two had written.

Fellow student Li Luo:

I'm Liu Shaowen, from the same class as Ying Chanxi.

It's a pleasure to meet you.

I hope we can have pleasant discussions in future literary society activities.

—Liu Shaowen

September 6, 2014

Liu Shaowen's letter was very short.

But the one he wrote to Ying Chanxi was probably quite long.

This letter to him was purely a clumsy attempt at misdirection.

Li Luo shook his head with a chuckle, picked up Qin Yawei's letter, and opened it to read.

Well, well... this one had written quite a lot.

(End of Chapter)
